fusions.name: Couched Lance
fusions.desc: Charges an iron-tipped lance into an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 30 damage that always lands as a critical hit. Its damage rises 5% for each stretch you have galloped, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Rearing Crash
fusions.desc: Rears and crashes down, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Warhorse in Barding
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to call a barded warhorse that fights beside you for 15 seconds, striking for 6 damage every 1.5 seconds. It draws the attention of your last target.

fusions.name: Road-Shod
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
